Meta.title: See your beach on Sunbnb
Meta.description: Enter your beach and number of sunbeds and see them on the map, ready for guests to book online.

Hero.eyebrow: For beach clubs, sunbed concessions and hotels
Hero.title: See your beach on Sunbnb
Hero.subtitle: Tell us where your beach is and how many sunbeds you have. We'll lay them out on the satellite map, so you can see what your guests would book.

noshow.title: Front-row sunbeds, paid before guests arrive
noshow.subtitle: Guests choose their exact sunbed on a map and pay online. See it on your own beach — free, in under a minute.

cash.title: Stop handling cash on the sand
cash.subtitle: Guests pay by card when they book their sunbed or order drinks to it. See how it looks on your own beach.

online.title: Let tourists book your sunbeds online
online.subtitle: Put your exact sunbeds on a map guests can book from their phone. See it on your own beach now.

queue.title: No more queues at the sunbed kiosk
queue.subtitle: Guests arrive with a QR pass and walk straight to their sunbed. See it on your own beach.

Form.beachPlaceholder: Search for your beach or beach club

Form.errorSunbeds: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
Form.errorSearch: Search isn't available right now. Please try again in a moment.
Form.noResults: No matches. Try the beach or town name.
Form.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

Facts.f1: They pick a sunbed on your map, pay online and get a QR pass your staff can scan.
Facts.f2Title: Food and drinks from the sunbed
Facts.f2: Guests scan a QR code at their sunbed to order and pay from their phone.
Facts.f3: Runs in the browser on the phones, tablets and laptops you already have.

Pricing.line: Free to start. {commission}% commission only on purchases made through Sunbnb.

Mockup.shareHint: This page has its own link — bookmark or share it to come back to your beach.

Booking.title: Guest booking demo
Booking.empty: Tap any sunbed on the map. This is what your guests see when they book.
Booking.demoNote: Demo — no payment is taken and nothing is reserved.
Booking.passBody: The guest gets this pass on their phone. Your staff scan it on arrival.

Chat.title: Ask about Sunbnb
Chat.greeting: Hi! I'm Sunbnb's AI assistant. Ask me anything about running {beach} on Sunbnb — prices, payments, how guests book.
Chat.notice: AI assistant. Your messages are stored and sent to Anthropic to generate replies; if you share an email or phone, we'll contact you about a demo. <link>Privacy</link>
Chat.unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now — you can still request a demo below.
Chat.limit: This chat has reached its limit. Please use the demo form below and we'll get back to you.
Chat.rateLimited: You're sending messages too fast. Please wait a moment.
Chat.fallbackReply: Sorry, I couldn't answer that one. Could you rephrase it, or leave your email or phone and the team will help directly?
Chat.demoBooked: Demo requested — the team will be in touch.

Consent.title: Cookies
Consent.body: We use necessary cookies to run this site. With your permission we also use Meta and Google advertising cookies to measure our ads. <link>Privacy notice</link>
